onscreen_lines.desc: Location: 1 - Exterior Trade: 15 - Roofing 4585 - REROOF--7/16" DECK/SHINGLE- 17.00 SQ Remove roof to deck. Install 7/16" OSB over the entire roof. Install 15 lb felt. Install ice-and-dam underlayment where required. Install self-sealing, 25-year laminated architectural shingles. Replace all flashing, including valleys and roof edge. Flash and counterflash chimneys. Kick out flashing where flashing terminates at side walls. Color choice by owner. Install venting as required by the ICC code. Install a shingle-over ridge vent. Clean up and dispose of all exterior debris generated by the roof tear-off and replacement. Complete all work in accordance with the current International Residential Building Code.
